description: Get ready-to-paste code for a form in a given framework: html (no JavaScript), html_strict_csp, fetch, nextjs, astro, react, vue, nuxt, svelte, hugo, jekyll, framer, webflow. Insert it into the site as returned; it already includes the spam honeypot.

form_id.description: The form's ID, as returned by list_forms or create_form (12 letters and digits).

framework.description: The site's framework. html needs no JavaScript.

name: get_snippet
title: Get a form snippet
